name: Matou Shinji
source:
A participant in the Holy Grail War. He is a skilled hacker, and closely resembles his Fate/stay night counterpart in appearance. He is extremely arrogant, and his servant is Rider.

[spoiler]In reality, Shinji is actually an 8-year-old child.[/spoiler]
